description: This file defines the BillingService class responsible for managing phone number subscription billing, including creating checkout sessions and cancelling subscriptions, integrating with Stripe and internal repositories.

classes.name: BillingService
classes.description: A service class for handling billing operations related to phone numbers, including creating checkout sessions and cancelling subscriptions.

methods.name: generatePhoneNumberCheckoutSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for purchasing a phone number subscription, including setting metadata and URLs.

methods.name: cancelPhoneNumberSubscription
methods.description: Cancels an active phone number subscription, updates internal status, cancels Stripe subscription, and deletes the phone number from the AI service.
